name: labs/zhangxp93__pyinsts
title: Rohde & Schwarz FSV3030 spectrum analyzer
intro: Rohde & Schwarz FSV3030 spectrum analyzer, adapted from zhangxp93/pyinsts. It reads `marker_level`, `delta_marker_frequency` and `delta_marker_level`; sets `center_frequency`, `span`, `marker_frequency`, `error_display` and 1 more. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/zhangxp93__pyinsts --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/zhangxp93__pyinsts --backend fake --mcp
